name: DungeonMasonry
height_note: H 0..65535 spans height_range_m; mid level about 0.387

colour_spaces.N: linear, OpenGL (+Y up); flip green on Unreal import
colour_spaces.ORM: linear; R AO, G roughness, B metallic 0
colour_spaces.Macro: linear; R large, G medium, B small low-frequency variation, sample at 1/6 to 1/10 of the tile UV scale

method: Poly Haven stone_brick_wall_001 (coursed rough-faced ashlar, mixed block sizes, deeply recessed mortar), graded to the golden olive-brown of the original dungeon wall sprites. Walls only: horizontal courses along U
known_weaknesses: single scan at 2.5 m, the same as one wall module, so the block layout repeats per module unless the mesh UVs are offset (the wall kit does this); courses are 15-35 cm
wall_grime_mask: PlasterWall/T_Terrain_PlasterWall_WallGrime.png works for this set too (R damp at the base: blend toward DungeonMasonryDamp)
